exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Nothing to load here, so the app never asks for a weight; when every set reaches 15 it will tell you to make it harder. Too hard? Hands on a table. Too easy? Feet on a chair. Hands under the shoulders, body straight, chest to the floor.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.notes: Under a sturdy table, or a towel looped around a door handle. Body straight, pull the chest to the edge. Feet further back makes it harder.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.notes: Feet shoulder width, sit down between the knees, heels on the floor. Too easy? Slow the way down to three seconds.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: 10 to 12 each leg. Step back far enough that the front shin stays vertical.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Elbows under the shoulders, squeeze the glutes, one straight line. Too easy? Lift one foot.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: On your back, feet flat, drive the hips up and squeeze for a second at the top.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.notes: Hips high, head towards the floor between the hands. Feet on a chair makes it harder; this is the shoulder press of the plan.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: 8 to 12 each leg, rear foot on a chair. Hold a bag or a bottle in each hand once bodyweight is easy.

exercises.name: Chair Dip
exercises.notes: Hands on the edge of a chair behind you, lower until the elbows reach 90 degrees. Legs straight makes it harder.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: 10 to 15 each leg. Hips level; the free knee stays bent.

exercises.name: Superman Hold
exercises.notes: Face down, arms and legs lifted, look at the floor. This is the back of the plan.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: Alternate sides each set. Elbow under the shoulder, hips lifted, one straight line.
